title: Balochistan Local Government Second Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Local Government Second Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

BALOCHISTAN LOCAL GOVERNMENT
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XV OF 2002
An Ordinance further
to amend the Balochistan Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of
Balochistul, Extraordinary, 27th September, 2002]
No.1 Legis: 1-122/Law/2002,
dated 27-9-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 23rd September, 2002, is hereby published for general
information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Local
Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

No.1 Legis: 1-122/Law/2002,
dated 27-9-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of

information:--
2. Amendment of section 32 of Ordinance XVIII of 2001.---In the Balochistan Local Government
Ordinance, 2001, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 32,

An Ordinance further

[Gazette of
Balochistul, Extraordinary, 27th September, 2002]
No.1 Legis: 1-122/Law/2002,
dated 27-9-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 23rd September, 2002, is hereby published for general
information:--
3. Amendment of section 103 of Ordinance XVIII of 2001.-In the said Ordinance, in section
103, for the full-stop at the end of proviso a colon shall be substituted and
thereafter the following further provisos shall be added, namely:-- .
"Provided further that in bringing parties to a dispute to
an amicable settlement, Musalihat Anjuman shall have regard to the provisions
of section 345 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (Act V of 1898), Hudood laws
and all other laws for the time being in force whereunder certain offences are
not compoundable:
Provided also that every settlement brought by Musalihat Anjuman
in a case pending before a Court shall be subject to the approval of such
Court.".

4. Amendment of section 156 of Ordinance XVIII of 2001.-----In the said Ordinance, after
subsection (3) of section 156, the following new subsection shall be added:--.
"(3A). The period of one year referred to in subsection (3)
shall be computed from the date of assumption of office of the council:
Provided that in a year in which general elections are to be

5. Insertion of new section 181-A, Ordinance XVIII of 2001.---In the said Ordinance, after section

"181-A. Internal recall of Nazims.--Notwithstanding.

An Ordinance further
to amend the Balochistan Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of
Balochistul, Extraordinary, 27th September, 2002]
No.1 Legis: 1-122/Law/2002,
dated 27-9-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 23rd September, 2002, is hereby published for general
information:--
6. Amendment of section 185 of Ordinance XVIII of 2001.-----In the said Ordinance, after
subsection (2) of section 185, the following new subsection shall be added,
namely:--
"(3) Notwithstanding anything contained in sections 109 and
119, for fiscal year 2001-2002, the Local Governments may not set apart fifty
per cent. of the development budget for utilization specified therein:
Provided that the development schemes proposed by Citizen
Community Boards shall be given priority and included in the budget presented
to the Councils for approval.".
